description: Authoring and interchange format for CommunityMP multiplayer-native quests. ESM and ESP files can be converted into this model, but runtime servers consume generated questdb JSONL tables rather than Bethesda record formats.

packageFields.packageId: Stable package id. If omitted, the importer derives one.
packageFields.title: Human-readable package name.
packageFields.author: Package author or conversion tool.
packageFields.dependencies: Optional list of content or quest package dependencies.

quests.sourceQuestId: Optional legacy/client journal id. Defaults to questId.
quests.scopePolicy: player-default, party-shared, world-shared, or explicit custom policy.
quests.sharingPolicy: How quest state may be shared between characters.
quests.instancingPolicy: How the server separates quest-critical state between players or groups.
quests.steps: Ordered quest progress nodes with optional server-evaluated conditions and effects.

dialogueTopics.sourceTopicId: Optional legacy/client topic id. Defaults to topicId.
dialogueTopics.dialogueType: Topic, Greeting, Persuasion, Voice, Journal, or package-defined type.
dialogueTopics.responses: Server-evaluated dialogue responses with conditions and effects.

conditions.function: Condition function name such as Journal, Item count, Global, Local, or a native server predicate.
conditions.comparison: eq, ne, gt, ge, lt, or le.
conditions.variable: Quest, global, actor, or native variable id.
conditions.valueType: int, float, string, bool, or package-defined.
conditions.authorityFields: The importer derives evaluationScope, stateScope, authorityRequirement, and snapshotPolicy.

effects.effectKind: journal.set, topic.add, dialogue.goodbye, dialogue.choice, inventory.add, inventory.remove, actor.setFight, actor.startCombat, actor.modDisposition, or package-defined.
effects.transactionKind: quest-state, topic-state, dialogue-session, inventory, actor-cell, or manual-review.
effects.authorityRequirement: server-quest-state, server-topic-state, server-dialogue-session, server-inventory-ledger, cell-simulation-owner, or server-review.
effects.conflictPolicy: monotonic-journal-index, set-union, session-ordered, transactional-compare-and-swap, cell-authority-sequence, or manual-review.
effects.idempotencyKey: Optional stable replay key. If omitted, the importer derives one.
